entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: MTV Hits was a pan-regional pay television music video channel operated by Paramount Networks EMEAA, focusing on contemporary pop videos from the 2010s onward. It launched for EMEA on 27 May 2014 as part of a shift from UK-branded feeds to EMEA versions. In October 2025, reports indicated that several MTV-branded music channels in Europe switched off on 31 December 2025.
